error[ZC-E0105]: the service changed while it was being applied
  cause  service hello was changed by someone else during the request
  fix    look at it as it is now, then apply again   zcube get service hello
  more   zcube explain E0105 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0105.html
